tierModel.note: Our tiers are loosely based on FHEQ levels and overlap on purpose. Introductory runs L3 to the lower end of L5; Intermediate runs the top of L4 to the bottom of L6; Advanced runs the top of L5 to L7. Both axes are kept on every tiered item because both can be useful; the per-row fheqLevel is the single indicative level, the fheqRange is the tier's loose span.
